# The removed collapsed and expanded helpers asserted the message Elided flag

Before the paired cleanup, assert_collapsed and assert_expanded called _assert_elided_helper with true and false. That helper compared each database-view message flag with nsMsgMessageFlags.Elided and threw on a mismatch. It did not inspect DOM visibility. The later removal retires that assertion helper; the fixed-source collapse_all_threads and expand_all_threads functions remain command actions with a tick wait, not direct state assertions. No new scenario or passing test result follows from deleting the old exports.

Scope: Historical folder-display test helper retirement.
